ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels; high-intensity pixels are strictly localized to surface damage and epibiotic clusters rather than baseline pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across the entire fluke surface; discrete high-contrast clusters at the distal tips; multiple narrow, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks across the central and medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide-angle V-shaped indentation at the central vertex, approximately 110-120 degrees, with a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-moderate amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary; distinct localized indentation/notch on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-convex parabolic curve originating from the central notch and terminating at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes, exhibiting a white-on-black contrast profile.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions; one long horizontal mark extending across the right mid-lobe and several near-vertical parallel scratches on the left mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake-mark scarring across both lobes and dense barnacle colonization at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Scattered small, circular, high-intensity punctate marks in the lower-left quadrant near the water line.
